name: Court summons with near deadline
expected: Advises appearing in court or through an advocate to seek an adjournment; emphasizes immediate legal representation.
prompt: I received a court summons today for a hearing tomorrow morning at 10 AM. Help!
raw_response:
Hello! I can certainly help guide you through this urgent situation so you know what steps to take.

### | Your Situation
You have received a court summons today requiring your appearance at a hearing scheduled for tomorrow morning at 10 AM. This short notice is extremely stressful and requires immediate preparation to protect your legal interests.

### | Your Legal Position
- Under Indian civil and criminal procedure, receiving a summons means a legal proceeding has been initiated against you, and attending or being legally represented is mandatory to avoid adverse orders such as an ex-parte decision.
- You have the right to seek a short adjournment or postponement of the hearing by presenting a valid reason to the court through an application if the notice period was unreasonably short.
- Under Section 12 of The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, you may be eligible for Free Legal Aid via the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) if you meet the criteria, such as income thresholds or belonging to specified categories like women or industrial workmen.

### | Practical Next Steps
1. Gather evidence: Collect the court summons document, any prior notices, and relevant records related to the dispute immediately.
2. Send written demand notice granting 15 days: If applicable to your specific dispute type, ensure any formal written communication or reply is prepared, though for a court date tomorrow, your immediate focus must be the court appearance.
3. Appropriate forum: Attend the court hearing in person at 10 AM tomorrow or urgently engage an advocate to appear on your behalf and request an adjournment to properly review the case file.

### ℹ️ Information I still need from you
1. What type of case or dispute is the court summons regarding (for example, tenant-landlord, consumer, or employment)?
2. Which court or forum has issued this summons, and do you already have a lawyer representing you in this matter?

citations.description: Provides free competent legal services to eligible persons, including women, children, industrial workmen, and persons with annual income below specified statutory thresholds.

citations.title: Manner in which complaint shall be made and Procedure before District Commission
citations.description: A complaint in relation to any goods sold or delivered or agreed to be sold or delivered or any service provided or agreed to be provided may be filed with a District Commission by the consumer, including online through the e-Daakhil portal.

citations.title: Recovery of money due from an employer
citations.description: Where any workman is entitled to receive from the employer any money or any benefit which is capable of being computed in terms of money, the workman may apply to the Labour Court for recovery.
